scope: React personal library, automatic likes playlist, playlist detail, recent history and guild top

results.name: private likes load, 20-row pagination and existing typography
title/artist filtering and honest no-results state
explicit unlike ignores rapid duplicates and updates automatic collection count
Tus Me gusta appears as a playlist from the same hearts
single track and liked collection use existing playback contracts once
owned playlists open their actual tracks
recent personal activity and server top retain separate scopes
keyboard input focus and mobile layout
normal flows have zero browser warnings/errors and failed assets
retired provider like stays visible, cannot play and can be removed
empty likes retain the automatic playlist
storage failure is shown as an error, not an empty personal library
uncertain unlike is reconciled without toggling the heart back on
voice channel is explicitly requested when none is selected
failed playback is not retried automatically or by double click
revoked permissions clear library and playlist contents
expired session and CSRF failure clear private data
foreign account response cannot enter the rendered library
playlist ownership error never renders its songs
late playlist responses are ignored after opening another collection
switching servers during load does not mix server tops
write in progress blocks internal navigation

limits: No authenticated production OAuth or live playback test
Likes and playlists are loaded fully by existing repository; client pages contain 20 rows
Other client heart changes appear after refresh, not a new realtime event stream
Playlist creation/editing/deletion and full player migration retain existing flows
